actions: After this branch merges to main, open the Deploy run for that push, confirm it is green, and confirm https://fermi-plus.sallvain.workers.dev/manifest.webmanifest is served as JSON with name Fermi+ and display standalone, and that https://fermi-plus.sallvain.workers.dev/icons/icon-192.png, /icons/icon-512.png and /apple-touch-icon.png load as PNG images.

On your iPhone, open https://fermi-plus.sallvain.workers.dev/ in Safari, tap Share then Add to Home Screen, and confirm it offers the name Fermi+ with Fermi's icon (the purple F under the infinity sign on black).
Tap the saved Fermi+ icon on the Home Screen and confirm Fermi opens with no Safari address bar or toolbar.
